methods.name: Stage-Progression

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Charm Industrial is a Series B-stage climate and energy company founded by Peter Reinhardt and Shaun Meehan, having raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis benchmarks against a comparable set spanning 9 private and 1 public company in the Climate & Energy sector, including peers such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields an implied valuation of $190M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B.

These methods support a triangulated valuation range of $162M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $595M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific multiples in the climate-tech sector and the limited direct stage-match peer set. Stage-progression implies a more conservative floor, while peer comparables suggest substantially higher potential values. Key uncertainties include the applicability of Series C valuations to a Series B company and variance in comparable company funding trajectories and technology maturity.
